scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:check-sudo && pnpm run dev:root-agent:ensure && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "pnpm run dev:backend" "pnpm run dev:frontend:wait"
scripts.dev:root-agent:ensure: sh -c 'sudo pkill -f "/mana-panel-backend root-agent$" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; cargo build --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml && sudo -E nohup ./backend/target/debug/mana-panel-backend root-agent >/tmp/mana-panel-root-agent.log 2>&1 & node ./scripts/wait_root_agent.js'
scripts.dev:backend: sh -c 'cd backend && if cargo watch --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then cargo watch -x "run" -w src -w Cargo.toml; else echo "cargo-watch not found, falling back to cargo run"; cargo run; fi'
scripts.dev:frontend:wait: sh -c 'until curl -sSf http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/system/info >/dev/null 2>&1; do echo "waiting backend..."; sleep 1; done; pnpm --dir frontend run dev'
scripts.preview: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "pnpm run dev:backend" "pnpm run preview:frontend:wait"
scripts.preview:frontend:wait: sh -c 'until curl -sSf http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/system/info >/dev/null 2>&1; do echo "waiting backend..."; sleep 1; done; pnpm --dir frontend run preview'
scripts.build: pnpm run build:backend && pnpm run build:frontend
scripts.clean: cargo clean --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml && pnpm --dir frontend run clean
